note: Profiles whose SOUL does not yet state the canonical fleet block from agents/standing-rules.md (issue #873). An entry is legitimate only while it describes a REAL gap: once the profile states the block, `make check-agent-profiles` reports the entry STALE and it must be deleted. Each entry names the lane that owns the file, because only a lane may edit its own SOUL - and a gap with no owner is a gap nobody closes.
